scripts.build: pnpm --filter @plotweaver/shared build && pnpm --filter @plotweaver/api build && pnpm --filter @plotweaver/web build
scripts.test:phase1: pnpm --filter @plotweaver/api exec tsx tests/phase1.test.ts && pnpm --filter @plotweaver/api exec tsx tests/server.test.ts
scripts.test:phase3: pnpm --filter @plotweaver/web build && pnpm --filter @plotweaver/api exec tsx tests/verify-phase3.ts
